summary: Given that the end of the year was slightly better than expected, sales at constant exchange rates in fiscal year 2025 reached €918m, with organic growth of over 4% compared with fiscal year 2024. Press release | Presentation | Replay
body_markdown:
Given that the end of the year was slightly better than expected, sales at constant exchange rates in fiscal year 2025 reached €918m, with organic growth of over 4% compared with fiscal year 2024.
